title: Dijkstra Is NOT Greedy: A Global-to-Local Proof of Correctness
summary: Dijkstra's algorithm is traditionally classified as a greedy algorithm. We argue that this classification misrepresents the mechanism by which the algorithm determines shortest paths. We present a direct global-to-local proof of correctness. At each iteration, the algorithm identifies a shortest path over the entire set of paths whose endpoints remain unsolved. This global minimum is necessarily a shortest path to its own endpoint.
